Circuit material study - isolated comparison and driving
Downloaded 2026-11-02. All models/textures below are CC0-1.0.
Asset license: https://polyhaven.com/license
Legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Downloaded files are self-hosted: the game makes no live Poly Haven API calls.

Concrete Road Barrier - Amal Kumar / Poly Haven
https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_road_barrier
Original glTF + 1K textures retained unchanged. Runtime uses barrier-study.gltf/bin.
Derived mesh: spatial clustering, 60,928 -> 7,573 triangles; maximum source vertex
movement 0.03925 m. UV/normal seams retained by clustering keys; topology is approximate.
Scaled to fit the existing separator footprint (1.50 x 0.96 x 0.60 m per segment).
120 instances. Not a real-world safety certification. See optimization.json.

Modular Chainlink Fence - James Ray Cock; fence wire material Amal Kumar / Poly Haven
https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_chainlink_fence
Original 1K glTF has JPEG diffuse without transparency. Official wire opacity PNG
added as alpha map; original texture transform preserved; alpha test 0.5.
Double panel and post nodes selected from the modular source; unused parts not drawn.
84 panels, 85 posts, atop existing divider; ends 12 m before separator end.

Old Tyre - MP / Poly Haven
https://polyhaven.com/a/old_tyre
Original model and 1K textures; rotated into horizontal stacks. 36 instances.
Decorative spare tyres on apron, not new collision objects.

Grass Ground - Charlotte Baglioni / Poly Haven
https://polyhaven.com/a/grass_ground
1K diffuse, normal, roughness. 2.51 m tile; no displacement geometry.

Concrete Wall 001 - Dimitrios Savva (photography), Rico Cilliers (processing) / Poly Haven
https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_001
1K diffuse, normal, roughness; metric projection at 1.5 m tile.
Used on existing facility geometry; the pit building itself is still study geometry.

Concrete Wall 003 - Dimitrios Savva (photography), Rico Cilliers (processing) / Poly Haven
https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_003
Inspected alternative retained as source evidence; NOT loaded in the game.

Asphalt012 - ambientCG (previously present in project)
https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Asphalt012
CC0. Existing color, OpenGL normal and roughness now all connected in this study.
3 m repeating game scale; see ../../../assets/materials/LICENSE.txt for originals.

Per-asset provenance.json records exact source URLs, authors, download dates,
byte sizes and verified MD5 hashes. Runtime paths and placement are in art.mjs.
Original driving UI, vehicle art, save isolation and course layout are retained.

2026-11-02 layout comparison: the compact variant repositions the same barrier/fence instances to separator x=11m and tyres beside the smaller pit building. Asset geometry and source files are unchanged; the spacious variant retains the earlier placement.


Daylight scene comparison - added 2026-11-03
Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy - Greg Zaal / Poly Haven, CC0-1.0
https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy
https://polyhaven.com/license
Original 1K HDR retained unchanged, 1,637,206 bytes.
https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/1k/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_1k.hdr
SHA-256: 5477b7dbb2aea4a6947cb36b96339c119f90bf36a03b039af3254b5e6a22896d
MD5 matches official files API: ee096fe9e26ce29d8f110b5ba0579011
Runtime: same HDR used for sky and reflections; directional sun sampled from brightest sky pixel.
Existing Asphalt012 and Grass Ground textures reused with color variation and metric-scale verges.
Pit frames/canopy/roof details and starting gantry are project-authored geometry, not downloaded models.
Only look=daylight comparison uses this environment. Main game remains unchanged.
